PLAN "12-Week Upper Body Program: Shoulder-Safe Climber"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "upper-body strength without overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Restore and Rebuild (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Horizontal Push/Pull + Scap Control":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          chest_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Row Emphasis + Cuff/Scap":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Climber Support Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_pulldown 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
